name: Self-employed, CHF 120,000 net business income, city of Zurich
workings: Net income from self-employment 150,000.00 − 30,000.00 = 120,000.00; AHV/IV/EO at the full 10% (above 60,500) = 12,000.00. No ALV, no BVG.
Largest 3a contribution without a pension fund: 20% × (120,000.00 − 12,000.00) = 21,600.00; 21,600.00 paid, all deductible. Insurance premiums at the amount with pension contributions.
Simple tax 4,685.0000; cantonal 95% = 4,450.7500; communal (Zurich, 119%) = 5,575.1500; personal tax 24.
